articles.summary: Discover how Claire M. Fagin built an extraordinary career—from nurse and educator to dean and trail-blazer—championing the rights and recognition of nurses across decades.
articles.title: The Long, Productive Career of an Advocate for Nurses: Claire M. Fagin

articles.summary: The University of North Texas has approved a new nursing college offering BSN and MSN pathways starting Fall 2024 to bolster the region’s healthcare workforce. Learn how the program addresses Texas’ nursing shortage.
articles.title: The University of North Texas Launches a New Nursing Program
